raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fixes #45770.

## Motivation

With the global multimodal embedding cache enabled, every encoder TP rank
currently creates an embedding storage backend and an `EmbeddingCacheController`.
Each controller allocates and registers its own vision/audio pinned host pools
with a default combined budget of 4 GiB, and starts a cache I/O thread.

The encoder's cache-data path is already owned by rank 0: it performs lookup,
prefetch, staging, output assembly, and insertion. Other ranks participate in
cache-mask broadcasts and model computation for misses. Cached embeddings are
final encoder outputs, so those ranks do not need a copy of the cached data to
skip the corresponding forward computation. Their independently allocated
host pools therefore remain idle.

This change limits cache-data resources to rank 0 while preserving collective
participation on all encoder ranks.

## Modifications

### 1. Separate shared coordination from cache resource ownership

Move cache initialization into `MMEncoder._init_global_cache()`. It initializes
`mm_global_cache_enabled` on every rank and starts with no local controller or
cache coordination group. When caching is disabled, initialization returns at
that point.

For TP greater than one, every rank first participates in creating
`global_cache_tp_group`. Its membership comes from the existing TP CPU group,
and it uses Gloo for the CPU hit/fallback masks. Group creation happens before
the nonzero-rank return because it is a collective operation.

Only rank 0 then constructs the storage backend and `EmbeddingCacheController`.
Consequently, only rank 0 allocates/registers the host pools and starts the
controller's I/O thread. The existing embedding dimensions and model dtype
are passed through to that controller.

### 2. Keep nonzero ranks in the cache execution path

Previously, `batch_encode()` selected the cache path based on whether
`self.mm_global_cache` existed. After restricting controller ownership to
rank 0, that condition would cause other ranks to bypass cache coordination.

Select the path using the shared enabled flag instead:

```python
use_global_cache = self.mm_global_cache_enabled and not is_health_check
```

All ranks therefore enter the same cache flow even when nonzero ranks have
`mm_global_cache=None`. Health probes retain their existing cache bypass.

### 3. Give mask broadcasts their own encoder-owned group

Update `_broadcast_global_cache_mask()` to use `global_cache_tp_group` rather
than obtain a group through the local controller. Both the initial hit mask
and the later fallback mask remain available to every rank.

The controller now creates its internal `prefetch_tp_group` only when
`all_rank_get=True` and TP is greater than one. The encoder passes
`all_rank_get=False`, so constructing its controller on rank 0 no longer
invokes group creation that would also require the other ranks. Callers using
`all_rank_get=True` retain the controller group and the prefetch-completion
`all_reduce(MIN)` synchronization.

### 4. Preserve the existing request-level flow

Rank 0 determines cache hits and broadcasts the hit mask. All ranks compute
the same missing items while rank 0 prefetches the hits. Rank 0 then broadcasts
the fallback mask so that failed cache loads are recomputed consistently.
Only rank 0 assembles the complete embedding and stages it for downstream
delivery.

For example, if A is cached and B is missing, every rank computes only B;
rank 0 loads A and assembles `[A, B]`. If loading A fails, the fallback mask
makes every rank compute A before rank 0 assembles the result.

Pool paging, eviction, GET/PUT, host/device copying, and assembly algorithms
keep their existing implementations. Cache flags, default capacity, and
backend selection also retain their existing behavior.

## Memory impact

With the existing 4 GiB pool budget, aggregate embedding-pool capacity per
encoder instance is expected to change as follows:

| Encoder TP | Before | After | Expected reduction |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | approximately 4 GiB | approximately 4 GiB | 0 |
| 2 | approximately 8 GiB | approximately 4 GiB | approximately 4 GiB |
| 8 | approximately 32 GiB | approximately 4 GiB | approximately 28 GiB |

These are configured pool-capacity estimates, subject to page rounding.
Additional backend memory is excluded. Each independent encoder instance
retains its own rank 0 pool.

+"""Exercise real TP cache coordination with CPU substitutes for GPU/storage I/O."""
+
+import asyncio
+import tempfile
+import time
+import unittest
+from datetime import timedelta
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+import sglang.srt.disaggregation.encoder.server as encoder_server
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.encoder.server import MMEncoder
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Modality
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=25, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _CPUEmbeddingCache:
+    """Implement cache boundaries without CUDA, RDMA, or a storage service."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.global_entries = {}
+        self.local_entries = {}
+        self.fail_lookup = False
+        self.fail_get = False
+        self.fail_prefetch = False
+        self.fail_wait = False
+        self.puts = []
+
+    async def batch_is_exist(self, hashes):
+        if self.fail_lookup:
+            raise RuntimeError("injected lookup failure")
+        return [h in self.local_entries or h in self.global_entries for h in hashes]
+
+    def prefetch(self, req_id, hashes, token_counts, modality):
+        if self.fail_prefetch:
+            raise RuntimeError("injected prefetch failure")
+        if not self.fail_get:
+            for h in hashes:
+                if h not in self.local_entries:
+                    self.local_entries[h] = self.global_entries[h].clone()
+
+    def check_prefetch_progress(self, req_id):
+        if self.fail_wait:
+            raise TimeoutError("injected prefetch completion failure")
+        return True
+
+    def has_local_embedding(self, h):
+        return h in self.local_entries
+
+    def store_to_pool_async(self, hashes, tensors, modality):
+        for h, tensor in zip(hashes, tensors):
+            self.local_entries[h] = tensor.clone()
+        return []
+
+    def wait_store_to_pool(self, handles):
+        pass
+
+    def insert_batch(self, hashes, modality):
+        for h in hashes:
+            self.global_entries[h] = self.local_entries[h].clone()
+        self.puts.extend(hashes)
+
+    def get_embedding_dim(self, modality):
+        return 4
+
+    def get_pool_views(self, hashes):
+        return [[self.local_entries[h]] for h in hashes]
+
+    def release_pool_views(self, hashes):
+        pass
+
+
+async def _run_cache_scenarios(encoder, rank):
+    token_counts = [2, 3]
+    expected_slices = [
+        torch.full((count, 4), idx + 1, dtype=torch.float32)
+        for idx, count in enumerate(token_counts)
+    ]
+    scenarios = (
+        ("all_hit", [0, 1], {}, []),
+        ("partial_hit", [0], {}, [[1]]),
+        ("all_miss", [], {}, [[0, 1]]),
+        ("lookup_failure", [0, 1], {"fail_lookup": True}, [[0, 1]]),
+        ("get_failure", [0], {"fail_get": True}, [[1], [0]]),
+        ("prefetch_failure", [0], {"fail_prefetch": True}, [[1], [0]]),
+        ("completion_failure", [0], {"fail_wait": True}, [[1], [0]]),
+    )
+    for modality in (Modality.IMAGE, Modality.VIDEO, Modality.AUDIO):
+        for name, hits, failures, expected_calls in scenarios:
+            cache = encoder.mm_global_cache
+            hashes = [f"{modality.name}-{name}-{i}" for i in range(2)]
+            if rank == 0:
+                cache.global_entries = {hashes[i]: expected_slices[i] for i in hits}
+                cache.local_entries.clear()
+                cache.puts.clear()
+                for flag in ("fail_lookup", "fail_get", "fail_prefetch", "fail_wait"):
+                    setattr(cache, flag, failures.get(flag, False))
+            forward_calls = []
+
+            def get_features(indices):
+                forward_calls.append(list(indices))
+                embedding = torch.cat([expected_slices[i] for i in indices])
+                # A model collective makes mismatched forward decisions fail.
+                dist.all_reduce(embedding)
+                return embedding / dist.get_world_size()
+
+            ctx = SimpleNamespace(
+                req_id=f"{modality.name}-{name}",
+                num_items=2,
+                modality=modality,
+                str_mm_hashes=hashes if rank == 0 else None,
+                mm_feature=None,
+                get_feature_fn=get_features,
+                preprocess_result=SimpleNamespace(token_counts=token_counts),
+            )
+            result = await encoder._compute_global_cache_embedding(
+                ctx, keep_on_gpu=False
+            )
+            if encoder.background_tasks:
+                await asyncio.gather(*list(encoder.background_tasks))
+            assert forward_calls == expected_calls, (rank, name, forward_calls)
+            traces = [None, None]
+            dist.all_gather_object(traces, forward_calls)
+            assert traces[0] == traces[1], traces
+            if rank == 0:
+                torch.testing.assert_close(result, torch.cat(expected_slices))
+                assert result.shape == (5, 4)
+                assert result.dtype == torch.float32
+                assert len(cache.puts) == sum(
+                    len(indices) for indices in expected_calls
+                )
+                # Repeat without resetting the cache: local hits skip all forwards.
+                for flag in ("fail_lookup", "fail_get", "fail_prefetch", "fail_wait"):
+                    setattr(cache, flag, False)
+            else:
+                assert result is None
+                assert encoder.mm_global_cache is None
+            forward_calls.clear()
+            result = await encoder._compute_global_cache_embedding(
+                ctx, keep_on_gpu=False
+            )
+            assert not forward_calls, (rank, name, forward_calls)
+            if rank == 0:
+                torch.testing.assert_close(result, torch.cat(expected_slices))
+            else:
+                assert result is None
+
+
+def _cache_coordination_worker(rank, rendezvous):
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        "gloo",
+        init_method=rendezvous,
+        rank=rank,
+        world_size=2,
+        timeout=timedelta(seconds=20),
+    )
+    try:
+        encoder = MMEncoder.__new__(MMEncoder)
+        encoder.rank = rank
+        encoder._embedding_dims = {Modality.IMAGE: 4}
+        encoder._embedding_dtype = torch.float32
+        encoder.device = "cpu"
+        encoder.background_tasks = set()
+        encoder._build_model_mm_items = lambda feature, result, indices, modality: (
+            indices
+        )
+        parallel = SimpleNamespace(
+            tp_size=2,
+            tp_rank=rank,
+            tp_group=SimpleNamespace(cpu_group=dist.group.WORLD),
+        )
+        real_empty = torch.empty
+
+        def cpu_empty(*args, **kwargs):
+            kwargs.pop("pin_memory", None)
+            return real_empty(*args, **kwargs)
+
+        with (
+            patch.object(encoder_server, "get_parallel", return_value=parallel),
+            patch.object(
+                encoder_server,
+                "get_mm",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(
+                    enable_mm_global_cache=True, mm_global_cache_backend="mooncake"
+                ),
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.mem_cache.embedding_store.EmbeddingStoreFactory.create_backend"
+            ) as backend,
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.mem_cache.embedding_cache_controller.EmbeddingCacheController",
+                side_effect=lambda **kwargs: _CPUEmbeddingCache(),
+            ) as controller,
+            patch.object(encoder_server, "encoder_metrics_collector", None),
+            patch.object(torch, "empty", side_effect=cpu_empty),
+            patch.object(torch.cuda, "current_stream", return_value=Mock()),
+        ):
+            # Real initialization and mask groups: neither collective is mocked.
+            encoder._init_global_cache()
+            assert encoder.mm_global_cache_enabled
+            assert encoder.global_cache_tp_group is not None
+            assert controller.call_count == backend.call_count == int(rank == 0)
+            asyncio.run(_run_cache_scenarios(encoder, rank))
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+class TestEmbeddingCacheTPCoordination(CustomTestCase):
+    @unittest.skipUnless(dist.is_gloo_available(), "requires Gloo")
+    def test_two_rank_cache_pipeline(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="embedding-cache-tp-") as directory:
+            context = torch.multiprocessing.spawn(
+                _cache_coordination_worker,
+                args=((Path(directory) / "store").as_uri(),),
+                nprocs=2,
+                join=False,
+            )
+            deadline = time.monotonic() + 90
+            try:
+                while not context.join(timeout=1):
+                    if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                        self.fail("TP cache coordination exceeded 90 seconds")
+            finally:
+                for process in context.processes:
+                    if process.is_alive():
+                        process.terminate()
+                    process.join(timeout=5)
+                    if process.is_alive():
+                        process.kill()
+                        process.join(timeout=5)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""Regression tests for encoder rank-zero embedding cache ownership."""
+
+import asyncio
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock, patch
+
+import torch
+
+import sglang.srt.disaggregation.encoder.server as encoder_server
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.encoder.server import MMEncoder
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Modality
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=3, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestEncoderGlobalCache(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_initialization_owns_storage_only_on_rank_zero(self):
+        for enabled in (False, True):
+            for tp_size, rank in ((1, 0), (2, 0), (2, 1)):
+                with self.subTest(enabled=enabled, tp_size=tp_size, rank=rank):
+                    encoder = MMEncoder.__new__(MMEncoder)
+                    encoder.rank = rank
+                    encoder._embedding_dims = {Modality.IMAGE: 4}
+                    encoder._embedding_dtype = torch.float16
+                    cpu_group = object()
+                    parallel = SimpleNamespace(
+                        tp_size=tp_size,
+                        tp_group=SimpleNamespace(cpu_group=cpu_group),
+                    )
+                    with (
+                        patch.object(
+                            encoder_server,
+                            "get_mm",
+                            return_value=SimpleNamespace(
+                                enable_mm_global_cache=enabled,
+                                mm_global_cache_backend="mooncake",
+                            ),
+                        ),
+                        patch.object(
+                            encoder_server, "get_parallel", return_value=parallel
+                        ),
+                        patch.object(
+                            torch.distributed,
+                            "get_process_group_ranks",
+                            return_value=list(range(tp_size)),
+                        ) as get_ranks,
+                        patch.object(
+                            encoder_server, "create_custom_parallel_group"
+                        ) as create_group,
+                        patch(
+                            "sglang.srt.mem_cache.embedding_store.EmbeddingStoreFactory.create_backend"
+                        ) as create_backend,
+                        patch(
+                            "sglang.srt.mem_cache.embedding_cache_controller.EmbeddingCacheController"
+                        ) as controller,
+                    ):
+                        encoder._init_global_cache()
+
+                    self.assertEqual(encoder.mm_global_cache_enabled, enabled)
+                    if enabled and tp_size > 1:
+                        get_ranks.assert_called_once_with(cpu_group)
+                        create_group.assert_called_once_with(
+                            group_ranks=list(range(tp_size)), backend="gloo"
+                        )
+                        self.assertIs(
+                            encoder.global_cache_tp_group, create_group.return_value
+                        )
+                    else:
+                        get_ranks.assert_not_called()
+                        create_group.assert_not_called()
+                        self.assertIsNone(encoder.global_cache_tp_group)
